summary: SMIC Q2 2026 revenue hit $3.01B (+20% QoQ), beating estimates by 5.6%; EPS of $0.06 exceeded forecast by 61.3% on AI chip demand.
Gross margin improved to 25.3% from 20.1% prior quarter; EBITDA margin reached record 70.2% with operating cash flow of $2.52B.
Q3 guidance projects 2-4% sequential revenue growth to $3.07-3.13B; gross margin expected to rise further to 26-28% range.
AI peripheral chips, computing, industrial and automotive segments drove growth; utilization at 93.7% expected to reach 95% next quarter.
Depreciation forecast to rise 30% YoY to $4.9-5.0B in 2026, potentially peaking in 2027; company adding 8,000 wafers monthly capacity.
